answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a ferrous-grade vault before it may transact, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes expensive: each one must post real collateral. A raven-like reputation graph then tracks which identities actually deliver value, and misbehaving ones forfeit their stake. Newcomers start in a quarantined orchard of low-value tasks and earn trust only through verified work, forcing an attacker to pay and work for every fake identity.
